sloka: यमेवाधातुमिच्छन्ति तापसा: सततं वने।तस्यासौ दृश्यते धूम: सङ्कुल: कृष्णवर्त्मन: ॥ २.९९.१२॥
transliteration: yamevādhātumicchanti tāpasā: satataṁ vane।tasyāsau dṛśyate dhūma: saṅkula: kṛṣṇavartmana: ॥ 2.99.12॥

translations.english: Here is the thick smoke emanating from the blacktrailed fire maintained perpetually by the ascetics living in the forest.
